types.name: TicketResaleListing
docs: A custody-style secondary-market listing for a cNFT ticket.
During the listing window the cNFT leaf is owned by the listing PDA
(the seller transfers into custody on `list_ticket_resale`). Cancel
and buy both CPI into Bubblegum `transfer` with the listing PDA as
signer to move the leaf out. The PDA is then closed, refunding rent
to the seller.
PDA seeds: `[b"resale", merkle_tree, leaf_index_le]`. That combo is
globally unique per cNFT.

fields.name: leaf_index
docs: Bubblegum leaf index — together with merkle_tree uniquely identifies the cNFT.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce from the cNFT leaf (equals leaf_index for v1 but stored for CPI).

types.name: TicketTier
docs: A pricing / seating category within an Event. Events may define zero or
many tiers; when ≥1 exists, buyers purchase from a specific tier and that
tier's per-seat price / capacity overrides the event-level defaults.
PDA seeds: `[b"tier", event_pubkey, tier_id_le]`.

fields.name: color_hex
docs: Hex colour as ASCII without leading '#', e.g. b"FF5733".

fields.name: section_code
docs: Venue-facing section code that matches the SVG layout (e.g. "213", "Floor A").

fields.name: row_label
docs: Off-chain venue row label ("" when not a seated tier).

fields.name: seat_number
docs: Off-chain seat number within the row (0 when not a seated tier).
